posts.title: AI should be illegal until we figure out how to deal with its social consequences
posts.description: Artificial intelligence should be illegal until we figure out how to deal with its social consequences. This may sound extreme, but the speed at which AI is advancing is fundamentally incompatible with the speed at which societies can adapt to it.
